div.head: List of Abbreviations and Symbols
div.p: (Editors Note—This list does not include standard abbreviations in common usage; unusual abbreviations of rare occurrence which are clarified at appropriate points; and those abbreviations and contractions which, although uncommon, are understandable from the context.

list.item: A–H, Assistant Secretary of State for Occupied Areas (Hilldring)
AMFOGE, Allied Mission to Observe the Greek Elections
CA, Division of Chinese Affairs, Department of State
CAD, Civil Affairs Division, War Department
CA/MG, Civil Affairs/Military Government, War Department
CE, Division of Central European Affairs, Department of State
CID, (Army) Counter Intelligence Division, or Criminal Investigation Department (Burma)
CINCAFPAC, Commander-in-chief, Army Forces in Pacific
CINCFE, Commander-in-chief, Far East (U.S. Army Forces)
CP, Communist Party, or Division of Commercial Policy, Department of State
CSGPO, Chief of Staff, G–3, Plans and Operations Division
Delsec, indicator for telegrams from the United States Delegation to the Council of Foreign Ministers at meetings during 1947
DRF, Division of Research for Far East, Department of State
DS, Division of Protective Services, Department of State
ECAFE, Economic Commission for Asia and the Far East
EE, Division of Eastern European Affairs, Department of State
EUR, Office of European Affairs, Department of State
FE, Office of Far Eastern Affairs, Department of State
FEB, Far Eastern Bureau (Office) of Netherlands Foreign Office, Batavia
FEO, Far Eastern Office of Netherlands Foreign Office (Batavia)
GA, Division of German and Austrian Economic Affairs, Department of State, or (UN) General Assembly
Gadel, indicator for telegrams to the United States Delegation at the United Nation’s General Assembly
GARIOA, Government and Relief in Occupied Areas
GOC, General Officer Commanding, or Good Offices Committee (NEI)
ICJ, International Court of Justice (The Hague)
ILH, Division of International Labor, Social and Health Affairs, Department of State
IR, International Resources Division, Department of State
IS, Division of International Security Affairs, Department of State
JK, Division of Japanese and Korean Economic Affairs, Department of State
Kosmos, indicator for telegrams from the United States Delegation for non-Council of Foreign Ministers business at Fourth Session meetings in Moscow
ky, Administrative district in French Indochina (e.g., Cochin-China)
Le (or L), Legal Adviser’s Office, Department of State
Le/M (or L/M), Assistant Legal Adviser for military affairs and occupied areas, Department of State
Martel, indicator for telegrams from Secretary of State Marshall (abroad)
Moskco, indicator for telegrams to the United States Delegation for non-Council of Foreign Ministers business at Fourth Session meetings in Moscow
NA, Division of Northeast Asian Affairs, Department of State
NAC, National Advisory Council on International Monetary and Financial Problems
NEA, Office of Near Eastern and African Affairs, Department of State
Niact, communications indicator requiring attention by the recipient at any hour of the day or night
NOE, Division of Northern European Affairs, Department of State
OAC, Advisory Committee on Occupied Areas Affairs, Department of State
OE, Division of Occupied-Area Economic Affairs, Department of State
OFLC, Office of Foreign Liquidation Commissioner, Department of State
OIC, Office of International Information and Cultural Affairs, Department of State
OIR, Office of Intelligence Research, Department of State
P&O, Plans and Operations, War Department
PI, Division of Philippine Affairs, Department of State
PNI, Partai Nasional Indonesia (Indonesian nationalist party)
RDC, Representative Democratic Council (unofficial group in south Korea)
SANACC, State-Army-Navy-Air Force Coordinating Committee (successor of SWNCC)
SCAP, Supreme Commander, Allied Powers, Japan
SCINR, Special Committee for Implementation of November 1 Resolution (UN Security Council)
SEA, Division of Southeast Asian Affairs, Department of State, or Southeast Asia
Secdel, indicator for telegrams to the United States Delegation to Council of Foreign Ministers at meetings during 1947
SFE, Subcommittee on the Far East of SWNCC
SKILA (or Skila), South Korean Interim Legislative Assembly
SPA, Office of Special Political Affairs, Department of State
S/S–PR, Protocol Staff, Department of State
TelMar, indicator for telegrams to Secretary of State Marshall (abroad)
UNRRA, United Nations Relief and Rehabilitation Administration
USAFIK, U.S. Army Forces in Korea
USAMGIK, U.S. Army Military Government in Korea
V-J Day, the day of Japanese capitulation (September 2, 1945)
VNQDD, Vietnam Quoc Dan Dang (Vietnam Kumintang)
WE, Division of Western European Affairs, Department of State
WFTU, World Federation of Trade Unions
